motivation.global_threshold_problem: Near-zero relevance thresholds expose useful supported ranking but collapse open-set rejection.
motivation.hypothesis: An entailment-oriented multilingual signal can separate semantic relatedness from whether the requested action is actually supported by the registered operation.

model.integration_status: benchmark-only; no runtime dependency or default behavior change
model.hypothesis_template: The user is requesting exactly this operation: {operation_text}

architecture: Preserve existing semantic candidate recall and capability-fit stages.
Replace only the operation-fit pairwise relevance scorer with the frozen NLI entailment scorer.
Use the already-preregistered accepted-selector behavior to let an accepted registered operation control the single-call candidate.
Keep all choices bounded to the existing leading-tool registered endpoints.
Abstention remains fail-closed and no execution authority is created by NLI output.

selection_rule.primary: Among candidates passing every standing quality gate, choose highest supported exact-route accuracy; tie-break by lower false-route rate, then lower p95 latency.
selection_rule.no_passing_candidate: Reject the architecture for promotion and retain only diagnostic evidence.

research_hygiene: Do not use calibration or blind corpora for threshold selection.
Do not alter the threshold grid after inspecting the first NLI result.
Do not add family-specific negative examples from this development corpus to the NLI input.
If the architecture passes development gates, freeze it before any confirmation corpus is generated.
